concept_decisions: Keep concept asymmetric high mound, low shoulder and collapse scallop; reduce concept excessive separate clasts and mathematically conical hill. Unequal rounded crest and irregular footprint, granular integral surface with variable-size facets in one closed volume, not overlapping rocks. No evenly spaced terraces or deposited sediment stripes. DNR photo vegetation obscures sediment so composition follows accompanying primary text, not invented observed exposure.
